properties.digitized_from: Real block boundary, formed from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for the block-by-block plan walk-through (docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv): the owner asked directly why 'confirmed vacant' blocks weren't being traced and registered as planned, per this project's own Mission Rock precedent (docs/briefs/mission-rock-geometry.md) -- an unbuilt block gets the same transform-and-register discipline as a built one, not left as a bare note. same parking lot as 15A, east half. The plan's own Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this whole row light blue, the same category used for UCSF's other institutional buildings on this campus, but no specific named development or announced project was found for this parcel -- status left as 'planned' per the plan's own land-use designation, not a guessed project name. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) 'Same block as 15A (east half); that block is a parking lot' rests on our imagery observation (parked cars fill 15A and 15B in USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29), not on the cited Land Use Map, which shows 15A/15B as the two halves of one block and nothing about current use. (2) The Dec 2019 map colors the block 'UCSF' only, with no use type or build status; the 'implied: UCSF institutional' reading is withdrawn. UCSF's June 12, 2025 CAC deck (page 3, per its Long Range Development Plan) lists 'Block 15 - Housing' among 'Undeveloped parcels remaining', which supports status planned and use residential (`use` corrected from institutional). (3) 'Mission Bay South' in project_name is the plan-area label, not printed on the map (north-of-creek blocks are prefixed N). 2026-10-02: public-text pass. digitized_from, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- digitized_from: 'Real block boundary from real street geometry (src/block_fit.py load_blocks(), polygonized from data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson); the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.'; notes: 'No building on the site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'); parked cars fill the block in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation that no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this block 'UCSF' (no use type); UCSF's own June 2025 deck, citing its Long Range Development Plan, lists Block 15 as Housing. No specific project, developer, or timeline was found in this pass.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
